title: Vibe Tracks KPI histories (real, every whole-bench point)

track_title.note: The track, as vt state titles it.

kpi.note: KPI id in the producer's kpi_series.jsonl.

label.note: The catalog's title (the id when the catalog has none).

t.note: When the producer wrote the point, as UTC (…Z): the producers mix offsets (Z, -07:00), so each is converted to the same instant in UTC.

value.note: The producer's value, never recomputed; rounded to 5 significant digits for display. Whole-bench points only (no slice); every point of each series, 20 or more each.

unit.note: The catalog's unit (× = a ratio against the reference implementation); null when the catalog gives none.

basis.note: The point's status in data-ui's words (measured, estimate, stand-in, claimed).

n.note: How many cases the producer's value is over (its own n).

sha.note: Code commit the producer measured, first 8.
